feeds.title: Isabel Eats
feeds.description: Here at Isabel Eats, you'll find a mix of all your favorite authentic Mexican recipes as well as Mexican-inspired dishes with a twist! Anything from Mexican Stuffed Peppers and a Healthy Avocado Salad to ooey-gooey cheesy Red Chicken Enchiladas and delicious Tres Leches Cake!

feeds.title: Muy Bueno Cookbook
feeds.description: Hola, I'm Yvette, an on-camera host, a home chef, an Emmy-winning producer and writer, award-winning food blogger. Here on Muy Bueno, I share delicious home-style Mexican recipes served with a heaping spoonful of heartwarming family stories. For me, food has become a way to share my cultural heritage and childhood memories with my family.

feeds.title: Mexican Please
feeds.description: Patrick is a foodie, freediver, author of Mexican Craving shares his culinary triumphs and failures on Mexican Please. Follow this blog that offers Mexican Food Recipes and Authentic Mexican Cooking Techniques by Patrick Calhoun.

feeds.title: Good Food in Mexico City
feeds.description: Nicholas Gilman is a food writer based in Mexico City. He's the author of Good Food in Mexico City. Everything you need to know about Mexico's culinary scene. From down-home street stalls to mom & pop restaurants to temples of fine dining, tipping guidelines and a grandmother's mole recipe, this is a gastronomic survival guide.

feeds.title: Dora's Table
feeds.description: Dora's Table is a vegan Mexican recipe blog. It provides delicious, easy and accessible recipes that stay true to traditional and regional Mexican cuisine.

feeds.title: Don Day in SMA Blog
feeds.description: Don Day is a former madman who in later life has become an explorer. After a career of writing ad copy, he decided to change directions and eat and drink his way through San Miguel de Allende, Mexico. These are some mostly short and occasionally tall tales of his adventures.

feeds.title: Mexican Food Journal
feeds.description: Mexican Food Journal is a food blog with authentic Mexican recipes, cooking tips and techniques, video, food photos, step-by-step instruction, interviews with Mexican cooks, people and stories behind Mexican cuisine.

feeds.title: Mexican Appetizers and More
feeds.description: HOLA! I am Cathy! Here we like to talk about food, especially Latin food and appetizers. Love Mexican, Puerto Rican and other Latin food. Come and indulge with me in some of the tastiest Latin appetizers and dishes.

feeds.title: Maricruz Avalos
feeds.description: Covers authentic Mexican recipes and Italian recipes for everyday meals with ingredients you can find anywhere.

feeds.title: Lola's Cocina
feeds.description: Dolores Wiarco Dweck, known by Lola, has a great appreciation for Mexican cuisine and culture. Lola's culinary mentors include her relatives and friends as well as some of Mexico's great chefs and home cooks. Follow her blog where she preserves and shares her favorite recipes through Lola's Cocina.

feeds.title: Muy Delish
feeds.description: Covers authentic recipes for the Mexican food lover! Ana's dishes are inspired by her native country Mexico and are mostly healthy with the occasional indulgent recipe.

feeds.title: Pati Jinich
feeds.description: Pati Jinich is the host of the popular Emmy and James Beard nominated PBS series Pati's Mexican Table, author of two cookbooks, and resident chef at the Mexican Cultural Institute in Washington, DC. This is her official website where she shares recipes from her show and new recipes in her blog, plus upcoming events, recent news, and more.

feeds.title: Benitos Mexican » Mexican Food
feeds.description: Benito's has been a restaurant icon in Fort Worth for over 30 years now and serves some of the best Home-Style Mexican Food in the city. Come to Benito's to enjoy authentic Mexican cuisine, prepared by cooks with 20 years of experience in homemade Mexican food!

feeds.title: La Mesa Mexican Restaurant » Food
feeds.description: La Mesa Mexican Restaurant serves authentic Mexican cuisine in a casual, family-friendly environment. Learn more about Mexican cuisine and authentic dishes at La Mesa Mexican Restaurant by Following this blog.

feeds.title: Mexican Food Memories Blog
feeds.description: I'm Karla, I am Blogger & food stylist, recipe developer. Come in and take a look at all the nice recipes that I write, and follow me on my Mexican food memories journey!

feeds.title: La Cocina de Leslie
feeds.description: La Cocina de Leslie is a collection of traditional Mexican Recipes and Mexican-inspired dishes from a Gringa living and cooking in Mexico. Get Authentic homemade Mexican recipes the whole family will love.

feeds.title: Mexico Cheese Blog
feeds.description: MexicoCheese.com is a celebration of the delicious cheeses of Mexico. Come join us on a journey through Mexico as we investigate the gastronomic history, the cheese-making regions, and the cuisine of this diverse and fascinating country.

feeds.title: MexGrocer.com Blog
feeds.description: MexGrocer an online grocery store for authentic Mexican food & cooking utensils delivered to your door. Follow this blog to get the latest news on Mexican Food, Grocery Brands, Authentic Recipes and Culture from Mexico.

feeds.title: A Mexican Cook
feeds.description: A passionate Mexican cook, foodie, food blogger, curious cook, baking enthusiast Lily Ramirez-Foran writes about Mexican food and how to cook it in Ireland.

feeds.title: Chilisalt Mexican Food » Recipes
feeds.description: Chilisalt is a blog that offers to easy taco recipes and other Mexican delicacies. It's a tribute to the tradition of eating tacos, to Mexican cuisine and its roots. This blog is dedicated to all food lovers looking for easy to make Mexican recipes.
